text_block_list.text:
One day, while training for the
upcoming Arima
Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And that's it for bench presses. Trainer,
can I take
a break?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Okay, just ten minutes.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
One... two... Come ooon, I've got three
more sets!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Hey, is that...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I follow Найс Нэйчер's gaze to find Tokai
Teio
training tirelessly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She seems to be using a machine
specifically
designed to help her
overcome particular physical

deficiencies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, Nature! ♪ Let's take a break
together!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Mayano! Perfect timing. What is Teio
doing over
there?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She's doing physical therapy! It was kind
of a
serious injury, after all.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Oh, really?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I mean, Teio was in bed the whole time!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I didn't know...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...Ouch, my legs are cramping up! Did I
push them
a bit too far?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: You seem motivated, Teio.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Prez! Of course! I'm doing
perfect!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
...I'd like to say that, at least, but I think
I'm still a
ways off.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
But I'll be fully recovered soon! I feel
like I'll come
back even faster than
before! ♪
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: I see...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I expected the first words out of your
mouth to be
a request for me to praise
your efforts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What?! I'd never do that! The time for
praise is
when I win!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Working hard is only natural! I can't
afford to slip
up now.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
If I don't recover soon, I won't be able to
run. If I
can't run... I won't catch up to
you, right?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
...I see. My apologies. I suppose I
underestimated
your mental strength.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You are at a point in your career when
your
abilities have stabilized, and you
are both
physically and mentally
well-rounded. I know it
would be tough
on me if I was injured now.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...So you came to cheer me up? Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Who do you think I am, Prez?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Successful in races and concerts! Faster,
stronger,
cooler than anyone else.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I'm Teio—no! I'm the Invincible Teio! I
can clear
any obstacle with ease!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Heh... That's right. I have high hopes for
you,
Токай Тейо!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't she seem even more energetic
than
before?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hitting an obstacle made her stronger,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Small-fry characters like me get all
confused
every time they hit an
obstacle.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But she stands back up so easily. Main
characters
are something else.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wonder if it was really that easy.
She was
crying a lot.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It didn't surprise me. She missed such an

important race, after all. She looked like
she was
having such a tough time.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I... didn't know. Teio...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер seems to have something on
her mind
в тренировке.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she starts to work her
feelings into
words bit by bit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I was convinced... Or maybe... I wanted
to
convince myself...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to think Teio is fast because
she is the
main character. That she was
born talented, and
the world works in
her favor.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
In order to protect myself, I told myself
that it's
only natural that she's different
from a side
character like me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But... that's just not true. Teio is the
same as I am.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She loses races despite her best efforts
and gets
injured. She knows about
making it through tough
times.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
What makes us different is... how we
react to
those struggles. Her strength is
the ability to
stand back up on her own.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...She really scares me now. I was
thinking maybe I
could win against her.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But unlike her, I'm a quitter—a coward
and
complainer constantly grumbling
about how life
isn't fair.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Even though it was me who got off the
stage,
saying I can't do it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I clearly don't know my place, and I
know I sound
like a greedy, spoiled brat
for saying this, but...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: But you still want to win.

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I guess that means she and I have that
one thing
in common. So maybe...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Maybe I can...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't finish the sentence, but the

determination shining in her eyes says it
all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Teio will definitely race in this year's
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win. I'm going to let the
world—and
Teio—know that I'm here
too!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
